span.p:
All edges shown are built.
Event types and the full consumer fan-out are in kafka-domain-topology.svg.
inventory-service publishes nothing, so inventory-events has no event types.
Checkout failures create no order row and publish nothing (ADR 0018).
Capture PaymentFailed writes order_reconciliation and does not release inventory;
DispatchFailed releases inventory. Dispatch outcomes are not mirrored into order-events.
OrderCancelled (US-9) fans out to payment (void), inventory (release), fulfilment (abort) and notification.
